subject: DPIA support: shadow infrastructure & subprocessor evidence needed
messages:
From: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@kontrolhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Zhou <kevin.zhou@legalbridge.io>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: DPIA support request — shadow infra / caching partner

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We had a follow-up from our privacy team: Kontrol is running a DPIA for our pilot and we need a concise evidence packet that explains the following for your service:

- A short architecture diagram showing where customer data flows when the edge cache/partner CDN is used (we call it "shadow infra")
- The list of subprocessors involved when an account opts into Dedicated caching or regional edge replication
- Confirmation of audit rights / how we can sample processing logs for the pilot period (Art. 30 / audit access)

Can you provide a single ZIP or a set of files we can attach to our DPIA? Preferably: a one-page diagram, a mapped subprocessor table, and a brief note on what evidence is available for 3rd-party caches.

I copied Kevin from Legalbridge who is helping validate the vendor packet. Can we have a first pass by EOD today? Pilot begins next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Lowe
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Kontrol Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@kontrolhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA support request — shadow infra / caching partner

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. We can definitely provide the packet. High-level plan:

1) Jonas will produce a one-page architecture diagram that highlights the shadow infra path and where KV/cache copies live.
2) Karthik will export our subprocessor table filtered for Dedicated caching/edge replication and include contract clauses (Art. 28 references).
3) Marissa will draft the short audit-rights note (how sampling/scope requests map to our evidence repository).

We have internal artifacts: a longer architecture PDF and an operational evidence index. We'll trim to the 1-page and a spreadsheet for your DPIA. I’ll attach a narrow-scope evidence index and a sample of the subprocessor questionnaire for quick validation.

Can you confirm whether Kontrol needs SOC2 test report excerpts or whether a controls summary + evidence access is sufficient for the pilot? That will determine what Marissa includes.

Will share first pass in ~3 hours.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma.lowe@kontrolhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA support request — shadow infra / caching partner

Emma / team — quick clarifications from Legal:

- Audit rights: we support time-boxed, scoped evidence requests for pilots. For the pilot period we can grant read-only access to a dedicated evidence bundle (logs, config snapshots, transfer manifests) via a secure share. Full onsite audits require the enterprise contract addendum.
- Art. 28 / Art. 30: our DPA includes standard processor obligations and the right to provide records of processing (we typically provide an extract of Article 30 register relevant to the account). The subprocessor list will include: CDN partner, telemetry provider, KMS provider, monitoring agent.
- Shadow infra specifics: the edge cache keeps ephemeral copies (TTL-controlled) and does not store persistent user PII beyond the session cache window. We will call this out explicitly in the evidence note.

I'll attach the draft audit-rights note and an exported subprocessor sheet. Priyom — tagging you on two follow-ups: (1) confirm TTL policies for edge replication and (2) let me know if there are any third-party contracts we need to redact before sending.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Counsel — Redwood Inference
[attachment: subprocessor-answers-20270507.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Kevin Zhou <kevin.zhou@legalbridge.io>

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPIA support request — shadow infra / caching partner

Thanks everyone — that packet looks good and addresses the DPIA reviewers' main questions. Two small asks from Kontrol's privacy team:

1) Can Redwood confirm the retention TTL for the edge cache in milliseconds / minutes and whether it is configurable per-customer?
2) We need a short note describing the sampling methodology if Kontrol requests a historical logs sample (what fields are redacted, sampling ratio, window).

If you can include those in an updated one-pager and send a ZIP (diagram + subprocessor spreadsheet + audit note + evidence-index.txt) we can attach it to our DPIA and close the loop today.

Appended: the ZIP will also be helpful for the HubSpot deal record (HB-9482).

Best,
Kevin
Kevin Zhou
Counsel — Legalbridge (external advisor to Kontrol)
